privacy.content:
隐私政策

本站是鼠王 Ratking 的个人作品展示站，用来介绍灯光系统、控制编程和互动装置项目。

收集哪些信息

本站目前不收集、不存储个人信息。联系表单是前端演示：填写的内容只留在当前浏览器中，不会发送到服务器，也不会被本站保存。邮箱和电话暂未公开。

第三方服务

本站不使用统计、广告或第三方追踪服务。

问题

如对本站的数据处理有疑问，可通过联系页留言（演示）或等待正式联系方式公布后联系。

cookies.content:
Cookie 政策

本站不使用广告、统计或第三方追踪 Cookie。

本地存储

为了记住你是否同意 Cookie 提示，本站仅在浏览器 localStorage 中保存一条同意记录。该记录不会发送到服务器。你可以随时通过页脚的「管理 Cookie 偏好」修改或清除它。

第三方 Cookie

本站不加载第三方 Cookie。页面所需的字体和素材均由本站直接提供。

privacy.content:
Privacy Policy

This is the personal portfolio of Ratking (鼠王), presenting lighting systems, control programming and interactive installation projects.

What is collected

This site does not currently collect or store personal data. The contact form is a front-end demo: what you type stays in your browser, is not sent to a server and is not saved by this site. Email and phone are not published yet.

Third parties

This site uses no analytics, advertising or third-party tracking services.

Questions

If you have a question about data handling, use the contact page (demo) or wait for the official contact details to be published.

cookies.content:
Cookie Policy

This site uses no advertising, analytics or third-party tracking cookies.

Local storage

To remember whether you accepted the cookie notice, this site stores a single consent record in your browser's localStorage. It is never sent to a server. You can change or clear it at any time via "Manage cookie preferences" in the footer.

Third-party cookies

This site loads no third-party cookies. Fonts and assets are served directly by this site.
